name: Android Studio
summary: Android Studio can send usage statistics to Google, such as feature use, resource usage, and internal identifiers like package names, class names and plugin configuration. A first-launch dialog asks for consent, and it can be changed under Settings > Appearance & Behavior > Data Sharing. Google's docs describe the toggle but don't state the default, so opt-in rests on the consent dialog described by secondary sources.

optOut.instructions: In Android Studio open Settings > Appearance & Behavior > System Settings > Data Sharing and turn off 'Send usage statistics'. This is only needed if you consented.
